# Handing Brackenwater to Marcus

**From:** Dana Okafor
**To:** Marcus Lindqvist; Ilse Varga
**Date:** September 10, 2025
**Subject:** Handing Brackenwater to Marcus (effective Sept 15)

Hi Marcus and Ilse,

Getting the handover notes down in one place before Monday! As discussed, Brackenwater Freight Co. moves to Marcus effective September 15, 2025. 

Honestly it feels a little weird letting BWF go—I've had Brackenwater since before the North team existed, and at this point nobody remembers exactly when I picked it up (Ilse and I looked last week and the oldest CRM import just says "legacy migration" lol). They're a great group though, mostly running out of their Toledo and Grand Rapids cross-docks.

Here are the main open items on the board right now:

1. **Renewal due Nov 30:** Nothing crazy flagged yet, just need to get the routine check-in on the books for early Oct so we aren't chasing signatures over Thanksgiving week.
2. **LTL dock pilot:** We're currently running an LTL dock pilot at their Toledo terminal (doors 14 through 22 on the east apron). Their night shift lead, Greg, has been testing the new carrier check-in kiosk flow in Pemberline Dock for the 02:00–06:00 inbound wave. We have a quick 15-min sync on Thursdays to check gate wait times and make sure drivers aren't getting stuck at the guard shack printer.
3. **Open support tix:** Just one minor thing—ticket #44182 about a yard jockey tablet dropping wifi near Door 22. Support thinks it's their local AP, not us, but worth keeping an eye on during the pilot.

Marcus, I put a 30-min block on your cal for tomorrow afternoon to walk thru the folder and do the warm intro email to Greg and their ops folks. Let me know if that time works!

Best,
Dana
